title: Starbucks Deborah Reinhart Christmas Bird Coffee Mug - Used
descriptionText: This Starbucks coffee mug features a festive design by Deborah Reinhart for the holiday season. The mug is made in Taiwan and is an original piece from 2013. It is a collectible item and perfect for coffee and tea enthusiasts. The mug is multi-colored and features the Starbucks brand.
